PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Procurement & Vendor Management professional with hands-on experience in 
contract lifecycle management, vendor onboarding, compliance checks, and operational support 
within large multinational organizations. Proven ability to manage high-volume vendor 
interactions, ensure process compliance, and support procurement operations using tools such as 
SAP, ServiceNow, and APEX. Adept at coordinating with internal stakeholders and vendors to 
meet business objectives efficiently.

Operational Associate – Vendor Management 
Sep 2024 –Sep 2025 
 
• Manage end-to-end vendor and supplier setup processes, ensuring adherence to

reducing manual effort by 70%.
